Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the birth year of King George V was 1866 based on the Britannica webpage metadata extract, despite the visible content of the webpage stating the birth year as 1865. The error occurs due to misinterpretation or over-reliance on partial information from the webpage metadata without cross-referencing the core text or verifying consistency with multiple trusted sources. This matches error patterns seen in Example 1 (Misinterpretation of Ground Truth) and Example 2 (Contradictory Outputs). Furthermore, the Planner prematurely marked the task as complete without resolving the discrepancy—a classic case of confirmation bias and failure to critically validate the data.
